title: Implement /feed.xml RSS feed generator for blog posts
description: Create RSS/Atom feed endpoint that publishes all blog posts for feed readers and content aggregators, enabling feed-based distribution and long-tail SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with proper Content-Type: application/rss+xml header
Feed includes all blog posts from lib/blog/blog-data.ts with title, description, link, pubDate, and guid
Each post link points to canonical URL (e.g., https://pelangimanager.com/blog/visa-run-guide-2026)
technicalNotes: File to create: app/feed.xml/route.ts using Next.js dynamic route with ResponseCache headers
File to create: lib/blog/feed-generator.ts exporting generateRSSFeed(posts: Post[]): string
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | head -20 to verify XML declaration and channel elements
Validation: npx rss-validator at feedvalidator.org or use xmllint --format to check structure

title: Add dynamic Open Graph images for blog posts using next/og
description: Create API endpoint generating shareable OG images for blog posts with hostel branding and post title, improving social sharing CTR and SERP appearance.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/og?title=Visa%20Run%20Guide&slug=visa-run-guide-2026 returns 1200x630px PNG with post title and Pelangi logo overlay
app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx generateMetadata() includes og:image pointing to /api/og?title=X&slug=Y
Image generation completes under 500ms for all existing blog posts
technicalNotes: File to create: app/api/og/route.tsx using @vercel/og ImageResponse with Tailwind classes
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx to add og:image in generateMetadata for social previews
Test command: curl 'http://localhost:3000/api/og?title=Test&slug=test-post' -o test.png && file test.png
Verify dimensions: npx sharp test.png or use identify command (ImageMagick)

title: Create blog category landing pages for long-tail SEO targeting
description: Add category field to blog data model and create /blog/category/[slug] landing pages targeting long-tail keywords (e.g., jobs, travel, visas) with category-specific schema markup.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post type includes categories: string[] field (e.g., ['jobs', 'visa', 'guide'])
/blog/category/jobs lists all job-related posts with CategoryCollectionPage schema
getStaticParams() prebuilds all category pages during npm run build with zero dynamic routes
technicalNotes: File to modify: lib/blog/blog-data.ts to add categories field to Post type definition
File to create: app/blog/category/[slug]/page.tsx with getStaticParams() for all unique categories
File to create: lib/blog/get-posts-by-category.ts function filterPostsByCategory(slug: string)
Test command: npm run build && ls -la .next/server/app/blog/category/ to verify prerendered files

title: Add Article JSON-LD schema to all blog post pages
description: Inject Article schema into blog post layout with author, datePublished, dateModified, and breadcrumbList for enhanced SERP rich snippets and knowledge graph integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post renders two schemas: Article with author.name, datePublished, image (og:image), and BreadcrumbList
BreadcrumbList includes /blog → /blog/category/[category] → /blog/[slug] with proper itemListElement structure
All blog posts pass Google's Rich Results Test with 0 critical schema errors
technicalNotes: File to create: lib/structured-data/article-schema.ts exporting generateArticleSchema(post: Post, baseUrl: string)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/layout.tsx to inject Article schema in layout metadata
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/blog/visa-run-guide-2026 | grep -o '<script type="application/ld+json"' | wc -l
Validate: npx schema-org-validator --url http://localhost:3000/blog/visa-run-guide-2026 --strict

title: Build JB News & Updates homepage widget with RSS feed parsing
description: Create reusable homepage widget fetching 3–5 latest news items from curated JB tourism/travel RSS feeds with fallback static content for reliability.
acceptanceCriteria: NewsWidget component displays on homepage below hero with title 'JB News & Updates'
Fetches and parses RSS feeds from 2–3 sources (e.g., JB tourism board, travel blogs) with 5s timeout
If all feeds timeout, renders fallback static news array without breaking page render
technicalNotes: File to create: components/home/NewsWidget.tsx React component with suspense boundary
File to create: lib/rss/feed-parser.ts exporting fetchRSSFeed(url: string): Promise<NewsItem[]>
File to modify: app/page.tsx to include <NewsWidget /> with Suspense fallback
Test command: npm run dev && curl http://localhost:3000 | grep -A 10 'JB News & Updates'
Build test: npm run build to ensure server-side RSS parsing doesn't exceed function timeout
